content:
Maya (AE): CrescentCare wants a 2-week POC next week. They have a custom model 'arcadia-llama-70b-finetuned-v2' (fp16). Needs streaming + kv-cache, p50 <200ms target, ~500 rps? actually 500 reqs/min steady with bursts. Can we onboard quickly?

Raj (SE): Need HF/S3 artifact link, model.config.json, tokenizer files, and notes on any custom ops (RMSNorm patch / FlashAttn version). Tokenizer mismatch is the #1 blocker for streaming.

Oliver (Solutions Eng): If artifact's standard we can spin a smoke. Recommend offering q4_0 variant for latency/cost tradeoffs — ask if they accept small quality delta.

PricingBot: Quick ballpark: Hosted fp16 70B = high per-token. q4_0 ~3x cheaper on compute. Dedicated trial adds GPU-hour minimum; will DM numbers.

Zoe (Security): Security checklist: customer KMS? data residency? retention policy? Hosted supports AWS KMS envelope; HSM/GCP needs Private/onboard. If they insist on HSM attestation mark as blocker.

Emily (SalesOps): POC SLA blurb: "POC is best-effort; enterprise SLAs only apply for Dedicated/Private contracts."

Maya (AE): I'll ask CrescentCare for artifacts + a 5-case multi-turn eval and KMS preference. Target to get everything by EOD so eng can start.

deploy-bot: queued: spin ephemeral arcadia-70b-smoke-instance (ephemeral) ETA ~40m

Raj (SE): If artifacts arrive today, compatibility scan + smoke in ~48h. I'll prep the regression eval harness.

Maya (AE): Thanks — will update here once I have links. :thumbsup:
